profile.headline: Software Engineer at Stripe
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer with an interest and passion for ML / Data Engineering, Distributed Systems, and Security.

I'm currently working at Stripe on Link focusing on all things Data. This includes partnering closely with Data Science to solve their engineering problems. 

Previously, I was working on VMware's Private Generative AI platform and also the Security ML Engineering team building Apache Flink pipelines leveraging ML models and working closely with Data Scientists to take their models to production. Before that, I worked at Wayfair focusing on big data batch processing using Apache Spark and Airflow in the Ad-tech organization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
AI & Advanced Services Team (October 2023 - Present):
• Developing the data extraction side of our Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline and implemented embedding generation from a multitude of data sources to support the team's new Generative AI platform 
• Built an LLM security chatbot, concentrating on MLOps tasks like Fine-Tuning and automating data collection for CVEs

Security Analytics ML Engineering Team at VMware Carbonblack (May 2021 - October 2023):
• Led, designed, and implemented a real time inference ML streaming pipeline with Apache Flink
• In partnership with data scientists, moved numerous models from development into production with Flask on Kubernetes 
• Created daily Spark jobs that perform that move tens of GBs of features into Cassandra for real time inference

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of the Batch Notifications team, responsible for daily processing and sending of hundreds of millions of marketing emails per day. 
• Active contributor to all of the teams Spark applications written in Java processing Terabytes of Data
• Migrated legacy on-prem applications over to GCP and Airflow
• Member of the on-call rotation responding to incidents 24/7

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: • Integrated Apple Wallet into Epic’s patient-facing mobile app MyChart and revamped the handling and display of digital insurance cards by creating an intuitive display and minimizing user input

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Organized and planned house build days by contacting the organizations office and by hosting volunteer meetings to help others who are less fortunate, engaging in numerous build days each year

- Actively manage fundraising efforts, such as HomeRun, an annual half-marathon and 5k event that raises thousands of dollars for the organization.

- Bought, cooked, and served food to nearly a hundred homeless men on Saturdays 
 - Planned and managed the purchasing and cooking of large quantities of food on a tight time schedule 
 - Conversed and interacted with the men during meals, building meaningful relationships and bringing positivity into their lives
